# SDL

The notices of the SDL libraries the Windows build ships, as `VERSION.txt` lists them: sdl2-compat 2.32.74
(github.com/libsdl-org/sdl2-compat, release-2.32.74) and SDL 3.4.20 (github.com/libsdl-org/SDL, release-3.4.20), both
under the zlib licence (`LICENSE.txt`). The DLLs themselves are not in the repository: they come with the build's tools.
